newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Talks on Brazil port dispute to resume May 12.
newsitem.headline: Talks on Brazil port dispute to resume May 12.

text.p: Stevedores from Brazil's key port of Santos will hold talks on May 12 with officials from local steel firm Cosipa to resolve a labor dispute which has already led to two strikes, officials said.
Stevedores are protesting over a decision by Cosipa to use its own workers to load and unload vessels at its private terminal in Santos.
Today union members presented a proposal which would reduce total costs for Cosipa by around 60 percent, said Antonio Pinho, second secretary at the Santos Stevedores Union.
A second session of talks had been scheduled for May 6 but these have been postponed "by mutual consent" until next week to allow Cosipa time to study the new proposal, a Cosipa press release said.
Union officials last month said they may consider further strikes should the current talks fail but for the time being, no action is planned, Pinho said.
